description.silhouette: Pallet stacked with dynamite crates under a draped olive tarp, a plunger detonator with T handle and a coil of fuse cord on the ground in front, inside the 96 px site canvas
description.colors: Stained crate timber with red warning bands, two opened crates showing red sticks, olive tarp, dark iron detonator handle and black fuse
description.anatomy: 1.7 by 1.36 m pallet on three runners; five crates of the carried crate model on the pallet and two stacked; plunger box 0.24 by 0.18 m with a 0.3 m T handle; loose sticks and a three-ring fuse coil. The stockpile stays as scenery after its crates leave.

standard.label: Stained crate timber, red paper sticks, matte iron
